name: The Gangster Next Door
source:
As you open the door of you home after a long day of work, you discover your (handsome) neighbor sitting on your couch with bloody clothes.

[From [url=https://kakera-art.itch.io/the-gangster-next-door]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你结束一天的工作后打开家门时，你发现你的（英俊的）邻居穿着血淋淋的衣服坐在你的沙发上。

[来自[url=https://kakera-art.itch.io/the-gangster-next-door]itch.io[/url]]
